query:
update auth_requests
                set interaction_id_hash = $3,
                    interaction_state = '{}'::jsonb,
                    session_id = null,
                    passkey_challenge = null,
                    passkey_challenge_expires_at = null
              where tenant_id = $1
                and request_uri_hash = $2
                and consumed_at is null
                and expires_at > $4
